comment: Released AL3A10 bitstreams. Checked by tools/bitstreams.py (CI) and packed into the release by release.yml. Human-readable: BITSTREAMS.md.

features: external trigger on the calibration pin
decimation filter: boxcar, CIC2, CIC3, 16-bit samples
deterministic record start and A/B order at divided rates
bitstreams.bench: flashed 2026-10-19 16:27; CH2 core A garbled in about 40 % of full-rate captures (docs/hardware-status.md 16:48)

features: stateless ADC encode (B-first order guaranteed at every rate)
bitstreams.bench: built 2026-10-19 17:30, all testbench steps pass on seeds 12345 and 3; flash session pending (fpga/al3/README.md section 8); flashed 2026-10-19 17:46: encode clean, but the MCU readout mixes bytes near multi-bit code boundaries (hardware-status 18:35): superseded by 0x1539

features: MCU readout byte loaded on the strobe start and held (fixes bit mixing near code boundaries)
bitstreams.bench: built 2026-10-19 19:50, tb 10 steps pass on seeds 12345 and 3 incl. tb_mcuread (all 256 codes, swept strobe timing); flash session pending (fpga/al3/README.md section 9); flashed 2026-10-19 20:06: CAL_PROBE passes, but both A cores still garbled at means 128..145 at 200 MS/s (hardware-status 20:25): the ADC data capture window, not the readout; superseded by 0x153A

features: ADC data captured through IOB DDR registers at a selectable 2.5 ns stage per core, against the write clock edge the core is encoded on (fixes the garbled A/B cores near multi-bit code boundaries of 0x1537..0x1539, at every sample rate)
core order B first by T/2 at every rate by construction
capture self-check: outlier counters per core (read 0x36), stage and B-reference register 0x63, threshold 0x64
0x53 bits 3/4 inert; legacy data 4 words (200 MSa/s) / 3 words later than 0x1539, EXT not delayed
bitstreams.bench: flashed 2026-10-20 10:03 (pre-write dump = 0x1539, verified); benched 10-20 10:04-10:49 on fw 0.2.79..0.2.82: the wizard trains the capture stages (this unit 0x08E3: CH1 A3 B4, CH2 A3 B4; the power-on 0x08E4 was bad for CH1 A at two codes), then the dcoffset sweep over codes 109..135 at 200 / 100 / 50 / 20 MSa/s is clean on every core (no rails, no jumps, max std 1.0 / 1.5 / 3.6 / 2.5 at 200 MSa/s) and the self-check flagged 0 of 18865 captures; the 0x64 threshold must be 32 (fw 0.2.80+: 8 sits under CH2's 3-code noise at 5 V/div); the fault of 0x1535..0x1539 is gone. Needs fw 0.2.81+ for the training (older firmware runs the power-on stages, which can be wrong per unit). Built 2026-10-19 22:19 (fpga-gen9); tb 11 steps pass incl. tb_adccap (AD9288 transition model, pad delay sweep, all rates); capture margins >= 1.33 ns at the power-on stages at TT (fpga/al3/README.md section 10); not flashed; bench checks 1..7 of section 10

features: a record that ends on the auto time-out or on the firmware's forced stop (0x1A = 0 after the ring has wrapped) reports 0x14 = W - total + pretrigger, W the address after the last word written, so the record read from 0x14 - pretrigger is the newest total words, contiguous (0x1532..0x153A reported pretrigger: ring 0 .. total - 1, spliced when the stop fell inside)
the time-out ends only an untriggered capture: a trigger before it completes its post-trigger words (0x0E = total with a trigger gave a cut record)
no trigger is accepted after the stop: 0x18 describes the record
0x1A synchronised into the write clock domain; trigger_address and trigger_read_address frozen with the write enable
bitstreams.bench: built 2026-10-20 13:50 (fpga-gen11, build b2: clk_200MHz 0 errors, min period 4.583 ns; sample_write_clock 9.231 ns; capture margins >= 1.10 ns at the power-on stages at TT, train the stages after flashing as for 0x153A); tb: tb_timeout 75 checks 0 errors at 2048 words (the 0x153A source fails 30 of them: the bench splice), ext / decim / trigpos / firstrec / contract pass, the full 13-step run ALL PASS on seeds 12345 and 4242 (fpga-gen12, 2026-10-20: the two steps fpga-gen11 left not green were testbench artefacts, fpga/al3/AGENTS.md '0x153B flash-ready'); source unchanged since the build; flashed 2026-10-20 19:31 (verified 1391978c..; pre-write backup = the 0x153A padded image, rollback = write it back); the bench of 19:52 (docs/hardware-status.md) read every record as spliced, but the saved records hold no signal at all (code 128 +- 1 on both channels, 1 kHz fundamental under 0.1 code where the square gives about 113; the probes were off the post after the wizard's open-input run; README section 11 'Bench 2026-10-20 19:31-20:03', fpga-gen13), so nothing about the record geometry was measured; tb_timeout case B (fpga-gen13) models that host capture byte for byte and passes; still unbenched: README section 11 bench checks 0..6 with the probe on the post
